title: DVR from a finite QM sample set and validated analytic fit
summary: Mandatory finite sample budget; fit an appropriate analytic function to qualified electronic points; generate every additional DVR node from that function. Never launch QM for dense-grid refinement.
gates: Freeze an explicit finite QM sample budget before acquisition
Use qualified electronic points with consistent state identity and coordinates
Fit and validate an appropriate analytic function with in-budget held-out samples
Generate all intermediate and dense DVR nodes exclusively by evaluating the fit
DVR grid/basis/domain convergence must not trigger QM midpoint or grid jobs
Fail a deficient fit without launching additional electronic calculations
coordinate_policy: Retain coordinate identity, sampled domain, units, state and boundary conditions; no unqualified extrapolation.
backend_policy: This owner accepts existing sparse samples only and has no electronic backend callback. New electronic acquisition requires a separate explicitly authorized finite sample plan.
